swiss.context: Switzerland, November 2021–February 2022. Imagine that you want to buy a new Smartphone today because your existing device is defective and can no longer be repaired. Do this thought experiment even if you do not currently own one. Choose which of the two you would rather buy if you had to choose. Functional life means years of good operation without major repairs. Environmental impact refers to production. Energy efficiency A means very low electricity consumption and G very high consumption. Household income, if supplied, is monthly income after social contributions but before tax.
swiss.question: Which of the two products would you choose?
options: Smartphone A; Price: CHF 550; Functional life: 4 years; Env. production impact: Very low; Energy efficiency: G; Recyclability: Not recyclable; Repairability: Not repairable at all
Smartphone B; Price: CHF 1300; Functional life: 8 years; Env. production impact: Very low; Energy efficiency: G; Recyclability: Recyclable; Repairability: Not repairable at all
